lines.text: Absalom and the men of Israel entered Jerusalem with Ahithophel, and Hushai the Archite cheered for Absalom as king.
Ahithophel advised Absalom to sleep with his father's concubines, so a tent was pitched for Absalom on the roof.
Ahithophel asked to choose twelve thousand men and pursue David that night, striking down only the priests.
Hushai advised gathering all Israel from Dan to Beersheba, and Absalom and Israel preferred his advice.
Jonathan and Ahimaaz hid in a well in Bahurim, and David's people crossed the Jordan by daybreak.
